content.text: **Commit B** — fix the roger-roger rerun leak. Route roger-roger to its dedicated no-rerun task:

input.old_string: run: mise run test:e2e --agent ${{ matrix.agent }} ${{ matrix.agent == 'roger-roger' && 'TestExternalAgent' || '' }}
input.new_string:
# roger-roger is deterministic, so it runs through its dedicated task,
        # which does NOT enable --rerun-fails. Routing it through the default
        # task (`test:e2e`) would retry a real regression and mask it.
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.agent }}" = "roger-roger" ]; then
            mise run test:e2e:roger-roger TestExternalAgent
          else
            mise run test:e2e --agent ${{ matrix.agent }}
          fi

input.command:
cd /Users/paul/.claude/worktrees/cli/magical-yawning-matsumoto
git add .github/workflows/e2e.yml
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
e2e: keep roger-roger off rerun-fails (PR #1577 review)

The default test:e2e task now enables gotestsum --rerun-fails=1, but the
workflow invoked the deterministic roger-roger agent through that same
task, so a real roger-roger regression could be retried and masked.
Route roger-roger through its dedicated test:e2e:roger-roger task, which
has no reruns.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
